params.caption: 🕹️ US October sales: Modern Warfare 4 No. 1, console sales grow despite higher prices Circana's October report puts Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 at No. 1 in the US across digital and retail, ahead of Gears of War: E-Day and Star Wars: Galactic Racer, though it still misses 2026's top 10 so far. Hardware grew despite higher prices: PS5 units +5% (average price +13%), Xbox Series X|S units +10% (price +29%), and Switch 2 was October's top console in units and dollars. 🕒 Nov 19, 2026 · 17:01 (GMT+3) 📰 Sources: Eurogamer · GameSpot 👥 @CallofDuty · @PlayStation 📈 Surprised?
